title: Luxe Studio | Near Broadway & Music Row w/ Parking
description:
This professionally designed studio is minutes from Nashville’s top venues and 2 miles from Broadway - perfect for concerts and couples’ getaways.

Enjoy reserved parking, easy self-check-in, a fully stocked coffee station, high-end finishes, a spacious walk-in shower, and a comfortable home base close to it all.

7 mins ➟ Broadway / Bridgestone / Ryman 🎶
10 mins ➟ Music Row / 12 South 🛍️
15 mins ➟ Opryland 🎸
15 mins ➟ Nashville Airport (BNA) ✈️

The space
The studio sits on the third floor with a great city view at night. 

Please note that the building does not have an elevator! It is not suitable for guests who cannot walk up 2 flights of stairs. Stairs are exterior and do have a banister.

BRAND NEW Vannie's Table (@vannies.table) is located directly across the street and Birria Babe (@birriababenash) Food Truck is parked outside the complex on weekends! Retrograde Coffee, AROI by Smiley Thai, Swett’s Soul Food, and Blackstone Brewing are also all within walking distance. For Broadway and most other venues, rideshare or scooter/bike gets you there in minutes.

If you're looking to veg-out, the living room has a mounted rotatable TV with complimentary Apple TV, Netflix, and Peacock. You can access your personal Hulu and all other accounts through the Roku.

Why Guests Love Their Stay:
• Exceptionally clean and thoughtfully stocked
• Quiet neighborhood with easy access to venues
• Comfortable bed and spa-like walk-in shower
• Seamless self-check-in with smart keypad access
• Feels like a home - not just a place to sleep

"The house and bathroom and kitchen were truly clean, better than a 5 star hotel." - Shiva, July '26

"The unit itself was spotless, the dishes were clean, the bathroom was pristine." - Ana, June '26

"This host thought of EVERYTHING! And I'm hard to please.. we own a cleaning company." - Cristeena, April '26

Guest access
We will program a personal entry code for you to use during your visit. This code is unique to you and will only be active during your stay, adding a level of security and convenience for every guest.

You’ll receive your code and detailed check-in instructions prior to arrival, so you can come and go on your schedule, no keys or meetups required.

You’ll have full, private access to the studio, one reserved parking space in the complex lot, and additional free street parking nearby during your stay.

Other things to note
• If you plan to use the sofa sleeper, please let me know in advance so I can have it prepared.

• While a few nearby spots are walkable, most attractions and music venues are best reached by rideshare, scooter, or bike.

• You’ll be minutes from Nashville’s top concert venues, including the Broadway entertainment district, Bridgestone Arena, and the Ryman - making this a great home base for show nights.

• The location is also convenient for Vanderbilt, Belmont, TSU, Fisk, and several major hospitals, making it a great option for extended stays or travel professionals.
